overview_description.description: The Breakaway is a cycling training app that offers personalized coaching, performance analysis, and progress tracking for cyclists. It integrates with platforms like Strava, Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift, and Peloton to analyze power and heart rate data. The app breaks down efforts into twelve "Power Skills" across various time intervals, benchmarking performance against standards adjusted for age, gender, and body weight. Users can set goals, receive daily guidance, and participate in challenges to improve specific power intervals. The app also provides insights into recovery metrics, such as heart rate variability, to offer a comprehensive view of an athlete's performance.

product.name: Coach
product.description: An AI-powered cycling coach that sets weekly training targets and adjusts plans based on user activity.

product.name: Guidance
product.description: A daily workout recommendation system that advises cyclists on the type of ride or recovery needed each day.

product.name: Teams
product.description: A social feature that enables cyclists to train with friends for accountability and motivation.
